items: NYC weighs options instead of direct-hire mandate. Transport Topics, citing people with knowledge of the matter, reports lawmakers are considering replacing the Delivery Protection Act's direct-hire requirement with a menu of options. Amazon could employ workers directly, use carriers such as UPS or the U.S. Postal Service, or contract with independent third-party operators, and a City Council vote could come within a few weeks if lawmakers agree.

Advent, FedEx consortium completes InPost takeover. The Advent International, FedEx, A&R and PPF consortium used squeeze-out rights on Nov. 17 after reaching 98.49% ownership, leaving InPost fully private. InPost stays independent under its own brand, and its commercial agreements with FedEx let selected recipients use its European last-mile network.

GEODIS launches U.S. Final Mile Index. The first quarterly edition puts the Q3 2026 Final Mile Cost Index at 149.8 (2019 = 100), up 10.5% year over year. GEODIS said that is about three times the 3.5% rise in consumer prices.
